plainText:
Nobutoshi Canna (Japanese: 神奈延年 Kanna Nobutoshi) is a Japanese voice actor for .

==Biography==
Canna was born as Nobutoshi Hayashi on June 10, 1968 in , , , and became a voice actor and singer as an adult. Canna joined during , where he voiced several characters of the day. He then returned during , where he voiced a few . Canna is currently affiliated with the talent agency .
